name: Kamarda

routes.outcome: Official Government of West Bengal department page identifies Banglarbhumi as the web-based land-record system used to display migrated blocks' live land records. General state-system custodian evidence; it does not expose a Kamarda parcel response.

Official West Bengal government project document lists Kamarda among Khejuri-I block's localities and gives the Khejuri-I block contact. This is local administrative/block scope evidence, not parcel geometry.
Official Purba Medinipur district site has a Kamarda notice under Khejuri-I Block, confirming the district/block relationship. It is not a cadastral feature service.
Bounded anonymous GET timed out after 20 seconds. TLS verification remained enabled. No retry with disabled verification, credentials, CAPTCHA interaction, or guessed private endpoint was made.
Official Bengali/English state procedure page describes access to updated Record of Rights, khatian, plot information, and land documents. It does not provide anonymous parcel geometry.
Official state land-record procedure page confirms plot and khatian are land-record concepts in the state workflow; no parcel API or geometry was exposed.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: Banglarbhumi was identified as the first-party land-record system from the official West Bengal department page, but the live host timed out before current JavaScript/configuration could be inspected.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: Root public host only; no response body or parcel feature query obtained.

sourceFieldMapping.compositeKeyProvenance: Kamarda/Khejuri-I relationship comes from official government documents; no parcel composite key was observed.

localCustodianAssessment: Government of West Bengal is the evidenced state land-record custodian/system owner. Purba Medinipur district and Khejuri-I block are evidenced by first-party government pages/documents. No local registry office page or anonymous cadastral feature endpoint was directly reached; registryFound reflects the evidenced official land-record procedure/system, not a successful parcel lookup.
